# What the md: importer says when it cannot read a document. The claim is about
# the diagnostics rather than the SNGL it emits, which is why this is a script
# fixture and `testdata/markdown_import.txtar` is a golden.

# A path nothing is at names the file that was written, not the one on disk.
! sngl check missing.sngl
stderr 'md: reading "./nowhere.md"'

# A path that is not markdown is a mistake worth naming before the file is
# opened: an md: import of a .sngl is a typo, not a document with no blocks.
! sngl check wrong_suffix.sngl
stderr 'is not a markdown file'

# Frontmatter is the compiler's to parse, so its failures carry the file.
! sngl check bad_front.sngl
stderr 'guide.md'
stderr 'not a scalar'

# And a document that reads is a package holding one component, which is what
# the program renders.
sngl check ok.sngl
stdout 'ok'

-- missing.sngl --
import doc "md:./nowhere.md"

component main ui.node {
    doc.document
}
-- wrong_suffix.sngl --
import doc "md:./ok.sngl"

component main ui.node {
    doc.document
}
-- bad_front.sngl --
import doc "md:./guide.md"

component main ui.node {
    doc.document
}
-- guide.md --
---
tags: [a, b]
---

# Guide
-- ok.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import doc "md:./page.md"

ui.window #home(title="page") {
    doc.document
}

output {
    none {
        html
    }
}
-- page.md --
# Page

Words.
